create.name: Genevieve Tregor
create.bio:
Genevieve Tregor teaches Insight (Vipassana) meditation and mindfulness from Scottsdale, Arizona. She began practising in 2008 and has since spent more than eighteen months, all told, on intensive silent retreats. Her main teachers in the Western Insight tradition have been Gil Fronsdal, Howard Cohn and Bob Stahl, and she has also practised with Joseph Goldstein, Jack Kornfield and monastic teachers such as Thanissaro Bhikkhu. She started teaching in 2014, when she founded Insight Meditation Scottsdale as a sitting community for the greater Phoenix area, and spent six years as a member of the teaching staff on the MMTCP, the teacher-training programme run by Jack Kornfield and Tara Brach. She is also trained to teach the eight-week MBSR course and holds a master's degree in kinesiology.

Her teaching stays close to the early Buddhist sources while remaining practical: she presents mindfulness and loving-kindness as a way of meeting the whole of life rather than as a technique to apply. She leads silent daylong retreats in Scottsdale and live online courses on metta, and as founding teacher of One World Mindfulness she helps run multi-day online Insight retreats built to work across time zones, with guest teachers such as Jack Kornfield and Tara Brach. She writes essays on practice and has been published in Mindful magazine.

courses.title: Insight Meditation Daylong Retreat: The Gift of Presence
courses.description: A silent day of practice in the Insight tradition with the Insight Meditation Scottsdale community, held at a church sanctuary in Scottsdale. The day alternates guided and silent sitting with walking meditation, includes loving-kindness practice and a chance to check in with the teacher, and suits beginners as well as experienced meditators.

courses.title: Cultivating A Peaceful Heart: The Practice of Loving-kindness (Metta)
courses.description: A seven-week live online course on metta, meeting on Sunday mornings (Pacific time) for ninety minutes. It explores loving-kindness and the related qualities of compassion, joy and equanimity as the companion to mindful awareness, with guided practice in each session. Dates are to be announced.

courses.title: Freeing the Heart, Awakening Insight
courses.description: A five-day live online Insight Meditation retreat from One World Mindfulness, where Genevieve is founding teacher, taught with Howard Cohn, Devin Berry and Tara Mulay, with Jack Kornfield and Tara Brach as guest teachers. Four two-hour teacher-led modules run each day, so people can join for part of the day or keep a full retreat schedule from home, with small-group teacher meetings.
courses.price: $650 USD base rate; $895 USD benefactor rate

free_resources.title: From 'Letting Go' to 'Being Present': Reclaiming the Clichés
free_resources.description: An essay on two phrases that have worn thin in meditation circles. Genevieve looks at how 'letting go' is often mistaken for suppression or renunciation, and what the original teaching points to instead.
